tiers.name: Idea & IP Protection — Basic
tiers.outcome: A clear, organized invention summary that turns an idea into something concrete and ready to move forward.

deliverables.title: 20–50 Minute Intake Session
deliverables.detail: A dedicated architectural review to extract your core concept. We move beyond surface-level ideas to identify the specific mechanical or digital logic that makes your invention unique.

deliverables.title: Core Invention Architecture (5–8 pages)
deliverables.detail: A highly structured translation of your raw idea into a professional engineering format. We define the exact components, the mechanical flow, and the intended outcome without marketing fluff. This is the foundational blueprint required before any real development begins.

deliverables.title: 1 Simple Logic Figure (Line Diagram)
deliverables.detail: A clean visual representation of the core mechanism. This diagram strips away aesthetic noise to show exactly how the primary components interact, serving as the first visual proof of concept for potential partners.

deliverables.title: Core Feature List + Alternatives
deliverables.detail: A definitive list of primary functions and potential variations. We document not just what the product does, but the specific "alternative embodiments" that could achieve the same result, widening the scope of your initial definition.

deliverables.title: Basic Friction Analysis
deliverables.detail: An initial stress-test of your concept against the laws of physics and basic logic. We identify the single most likely failure point (e.g., battery drain, material limits) before you spend capital building it, saving you from expensive pivots later.

deliverables.title: Filing Checklist + Next Steps
deliverables.detail: A prioritized roadmap for protecting your IP. We provide a clear, sequential list of actions required to move from this architectural draft to a formal provisional patent filing.

tiers.name: Idea & IP Protection — Standard
tiers.outcome: A structured, defensible invention packet suitable for patent discussions, partners, or next-stage development.

deliverables.title: Full Inventor Packet (8–14 pages)
deliverables.detail: Expanded technical documentation ready for deeper review. This dossier includes detailed system logic, user flow descriptions, and mechanical constraints required for a patent attorney to begin their work.

deliverables.title: 1–3 Complex Figures
deliverables.detail: Detailed system and flow diagrams illustrating the mechanism. These visuals map the complete operational loop of the invention, providing a "visual truth" that complements the written architecture.

deliverables.title: "Teaching-Away" Argument
deliverables.detail: The critical narrative required to prove your invention is truly novel. We analyze how current industry standards attempt to solve your problem and explicitly document why those standard methods fail. By proving your solution "teaches away" from the norm, we establish the foundation for a strong patent claim.

deliverables.title: Residual Risk Matrix
deliverables.detail: A comprehensive grid detailing secondary risks (supply chain, user adoption, regulatory) to ensure you are building a viable business, not just a gadget. We identify the operational hurdles that often kill great inventions after the engineering is done.

deliverables.title: Alternative Embodiments (A-B-C Options)
deliverables.detail: We map out multiple ways to physically build your invention to achieve the same result. By documenting these alternatives early, you widen your "defensive moat," preventing competitors from easily designing around your primary idea.

deliverables.title: Light Prior-Art Scan (Standard)
deliverables.detail: A targeted keyword search of existing patents to identify obvious roadblocks early. We highlight existing solutions that closely mirror your concept, allowing you to pivot your design before paying expensive legal fees.

tiers.name: Idea & IP Protection — Premium
tiers.outcome: A polished, attorney-ready invention package designed to maximize protection options and reduce future rework.

deliverables.title: Attorney-Ready Patent Dossier (15+ pages)
deliverables.detail: A rigorous structural appendix designed to hand directly to counsel. This document uses the specific language and structure required for patent filings, minimizing the billable hours your attorney needs to spend rewriting your idea.

deliverables.title: 1–5 High-Fidelity Diagrams
deliverables.detail: Clean, consistent Mermaid.js logic visualizations. These diagrams provide an indisputable map of the invention's logic, suitable for inclusion in formal patent applications or investor due diligence rooms.

deliverables.title: Preliminary FTO (Freedom-To-Operate) Analysis
deliverables.detail: A deep-dive assessment designed to determine if you can legally commercialize your product without infringing on active patents. We map your specific mechanisms against the "minefield" of the current intellectual property landscape to minimize the risk of catastrophic litigation.

deliverables.title: Claim-Theme Map
deliverables.detail: We translate your engineering mechanics into the specific, strategic language that patent attorneys use to draft claims. This bridges the gap between the "inventor's vision" and the "lawyer's reality," saving you thousands of dollars in billable hours when you officially file.

deliverables.title: Strategic Pivot Recommendations
deliverables.detail: If our logic audits detect a fatal flaw in your design, we do not simply reject the idea. We provide actionable, physics-based pivot strategies to rescue the core intent of your invention using alternative, viable mechanisms.

deliverables.title: Deep “Teaching-Away” Analysis
deliverables.detail: Advanced forensic argumentation for non-obviousness. We construct a multi-layered narrative that proactively defends your invention against potential "obviousness" rejections by the patent office.

deliverables.title: Two Revision Rounds
deliverables.detail: Iterative refinement to ensure the dossier is bulletproof. We work with you to fine-tune the technical language and visual diagrams until they perfectly represent your vision.

deliverables.title: Target Audience Avatar

deliverables.title: Basic Logic Stress Test

deliverables.title: 30-Day Prioritized Action Roadmap
